comparison.objective: Wipe left then right marked patches around a cup and return the sponge; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered surface wiping with obstacle avoidance and sponge transport versus hex-key insertion, bimanual counterholding, collar rotation, bounded tightening, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Only the ordered instruction is present; scoring, run limit, fidelity, reset notes, clearing threshold, cup-motion tolerance, and hold requirements are all missing. Candidate requires two quantified safe stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: The available complete spec tests ordered cleaning around an obstacle, not adjustment or validation of an energy absorber; its missing rubric details do not make duplication plausible.
